featured_reviews.name: Shubham Pawar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I visited this place because I had heard good reviews about 3M. Unfortunately, my experience was extremely disappointing.

I got a detailed car wash done for my Virtus after a Konkan trip (and if you’re from Konkan, you know how stubborn that red soil can be). I received a call in the evening saying the car was ready. From a distance, it looked great — almost like a brand new car. But that impression lasted only a few seconds.

As soon as I inspected it closely, I realized the job was far from complete. The cleaning was poorly done, with multiple spots clearly missed. I’ve attached pictures of the “great work” done by the team — honestly, I could have done a better job at home.

Paying ₹1800 for this level of service is unacceptable. For a brand like 3M, this was nowhere close to expectations. Definitely not worth your hard-earned money — I would strongly suggest looking for better options nearby if you genuinely care about your car.

To be fair, I did call the store manager, Mr. Yamin, the next day (he had already left when I picked up the car). He was courteous and asked me to bring the car back for a rework. But honestly, what’s the point of spending more time and fuel to fix something that should have been done right the first time?

What really got me was when I was pointing out the missed spots, one of the staff casually asked, “Sir aur kahin gandi dikh rahi hai car?” — I mean, if I have to find and point out every issue, I might as well wash the car myself.

PLEASE STAY AWAY FROM THIS PLACE and save your money. 3M products may be premium, but the service here certainly isn’t. I was even considering getting my roof blackened here, but after this experience, I’d much rather spend my money elsewhere.
